text: If I could give them zero stars I'll do it. After playing for a while it just gets impossible to play unless you spend lots of money. On top of that the game glitches and I lost many rewards because of that. It's getting impossible to find a good merging game since they all started to use AI. They're all bad copies of each other, it gets boring

After spending £40+ on this game I find it so gross that I'm no longer offered any packs under £5, not even offered the free 25 energy for watching an ad. You ought to reward paying customers, not squeeze them to pay more for less. They were not worth the price to begin with, but a tax for the idiocy of spending money on this game, taking away the semi-reasonable £1-2 packs, is just too much. You'll never change because it works, and that's so disappointing. Happy customers pay more. Do better.

I used to love this game, but the amount of energy you need to use for some of the tasks is making it virtually unplayable. I recently completed one task that used well over 1,000 energy to get one item. It is set up to force purchasing of energy if you want to progress at all. It wasn't like this previously - they have definitely made it worse.

The game started off really well but, In a recent update, the rewards for completing items has gotten significantly smaller, making the game pointless. There's roughly 5 minutes of gameplay and then you have to wait 3 hours for your energy to restore. Not to mention the constant pop ups to get you to pay to play. The game is completely pointless and I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.

Done with this game. I paid hundreds of pounds already and I feel like they kept prompting me into paying more when they noticed I was a paying player. Orders became impossible to fulfill without paying more. GREEDY. Now the app is no longer loading almost like they had my money and that's all. Stucks at 60% on loading. No update available. Scammers.

The game starts well and is engaging yet it quickly becomes too money driven. You expect this with "Freemium" games but unfortunately (like others), this takes it to the nth degree. The only constant pack to buy is £17.99. That's absolutely outrageous. It's also near impossible to complete your card sets. If you plan on playing and getting anywhere with the multiple events, you'll have to spend money. It's a shame no developer would do an ad version.

No multiplier option to get throughordersfaster, pressing the same thing hundreds of time to merge over and over again is boring 😴, also music is really annoying and the continuous arrows leading you to press things is annoying also early on in the game it already requires final 3rd merges so you're spending 3-4 hundred energy to complete 1 order. better music that doesn't put me to sleep and a multiplier option x2 x4 and I might of enjoyed it a bit more, just takes up to much time.

fun on lower levels, but as you get to the higher levels there's hardly any way to earn energy which mind you was shown as infinite so I'm losing interest in the game slowly. Way too many interruptions so often; becomes really annoying cards event of collecting won't let me finish collecting so I can't finish the even and win the enormous prize. Everything seems to be this way so you have to pay to win. Still feel the same way despite spending with them. Progress is very slow indeed!

Glitching... the mini games of discovering inside like a temple has been glitching from the beginning I cannot merge any items on the top row at all I contacted them through the in game option 3 times, I send them recording of the glitch also 3 times and nothing has been done a out it, spent several energy and nothing happened. they never fixed the issue i am not able to see the mini game to the end due to their own glitch and nothing to apologise for the game error nothing at all.

Well, this was the first dip of my toe into a Merge game. I thought I would get bored with all the merging, and to be honest, I did, however, the game is VERY addictive!!! I don't have an addictive personality, but I have spent a fortune, and now have nothing to show for it. The side games are fun, but you think you're playing for free, and when you come back to your board, lots of items that you've spent ages trying to get, have disappeared! I'm afraid I can't recommend.

This game is fun until about level 15-18, then they actively try to stop you from aging with constant pop ups. Loading up the game brings 10+pop ups, and then fulfilling an order brings 5+pop ups. Completely frustrating to constantly click off boxes. Progress also dramatically slows down, you'll be using thousands of energy to get a single item.

This game is so addictive and one of the best merge games. The storyline is very interesting but have few spelling and grammar errors which is a little irritating. I love the different events taking place. The progress in the game and items needed was great until level 15 or so, however, there were too many pop ups to ask you to buy energy. The energy finished so quickly it barely felt like I had played. It became a pay to win game.

This game has nice graphics and is very playable up until about level 18. After that, progress is painfully slow unless you're prepared to spend real money to get enough energy to create the matches you need. It's taken over 48 hours to create one item that I need. If there was a better balance between energy recharge rate and the cost to create items, it would be worthwhile. Edit: game is not too difficult. Game is flawed.

Fun idle game, and I like the side quests, but now can't play for more than a couple of minutes before running out of energy, so will move on to something else. I get that people buying energy packs helps support the app, but think the balance is off, could do with higher starting energy or more ways to gain energy without buying it every time.

This game is looooooooong. Starts off well the things take 12hrs to unlock. The energy goes too quickly and doesn't recharge up with much speed at all. Have to buy energy and gems to make it work. Overloaded with "offers" that cost real cash. Everything now takes 3x the levels of merging to make one item. Which often takes up all of energy just to merge 2 items the same then you have to buy more energy or wait almost 24hrs for a full charge. Game has become drawn out and becomes a bore. Deleting

I really enjoy the game, it is probably one of the best merge games I've played thus far. I would rate five-stars; however, all of the overly repetitive pop-ups for mini-games or purchasable game bonuses become extremely annoying. There are several that pop up anytime you maneuver throughout the game.

The greed is strong with this game. So you first start off playing the game for hours having fun and leveling up. But you start hitting the 30-40 level and you won't be able to play the game for more than 5-10mins. The game will bombard you with in-game ads and sales to get you to spend money. We aren't just talking about 2 either. You will open the game and oh spend this to play like 4 times in a row. Then it will force you into a event mode where, you guessed it, spend money here to play.

There are too many pop-ups that either force you to participate in events or pop-ups trying to get you to make purchases. The dialog is also really bad, there are a lot of grammatical errors and I stopped even reading them because it was so bad. I downloaded this app from a cash for gaming apps ans that was the only reason I continued. I Uninstalled after getting too annoyed with the constant pop-ups and forced events.

Close to uninstalling. Used to enjoy it Most purchases are too costly to bother, hardly any small purchase packs. No one is paying £10+ for energy etc which is gone in 2 minutes Generators have rare items that you can go through hundreds of energy to get no where near enough items. I'm at a point that all orders are those kind of items making it impossible to move forward To those reading, I'd say don't bother with this one. Fun until it's a total waste and more annoying than anything

Typical merge game. Tons of pop ups and events to try to get you to buy packs for more rewards. My biggest gripe with this game is actually the dialog. I'm not sure if they're going for a southern vibe or what but the writing is so bad and sometimes just wrong. Every other word is a contraction or shortened and trying so hard to sound cool. It's just cringey and ruins the story.

Don't waste your time. Initially, its a fun little game for those times you're stuck waiting somewhere and you need to kill 20 minutes. In the beginning, it'd easy to complete orders and tasks and you get lots of satisfying little achievements - but within a week or two, you'll be lucky to complete even one task or order in a sitting. The costs of upgrades are absurdly high for the value delivered, and even if you do pay, you'll still be lucky to finish one or two tasks.

the developers steal from unsuspecting players who get invested just enough to actually buy a package to complete an event. the % rate of various items that are dropped by the generators changes. when you are on free play, the game throws level items needed at first, then it throws high tiers not needed at half empty, eating up your free to play. when you buy a package, the high tier items drop to zero, which in effect, eats up your all purchased energy with all level 1 items. RipOff

This game is a rip off!! I won a chest for completing a side game/mission and added it to my grid and opened it, which requires tapping it multiplier times to release the "prizes." After clicking a few times I got a popup saying I was out of energy. I had just bought 250 energy so I was like no way. I'd it if that popup to check. The chest that I won cost me 16 energy per click. Forest they changed the daily chest to only have coins, now this? I've spent a good bit on this game. But no more!

As a game tester... day 2ish. Potential to Earn over $520. I have spent $3.99 and have made it to level 27. I missed the first $20.00 Turbo Bonus because I didn't hit level 30 in 1 day. Even if I don't achieve the Turbo bonuses I can still earn over $200 playing daily as time allows. The game is not plagued by technical issues and the energy is easy to generate through thoughtful play. It is addictive and spending money is an Option Not a Requirement to Play. One of The Best Merge Games.

tricky. they try to trick you into purchasing and buying all throughout this game. the recent trick is by putting a green button with the word "claim" ... doesn't sound sneaky, but after you have been playing the game for a while, you are used to clicking green buttons to CLAIM your prize. now they r trying use that 2 trick u into purchases. deceitful.

ever since the latest app update on June 13th, I've been unable to play the game. when I launch the app, it opens and tries to run/install the updates. but then it times out after 20 seconds saying unable to connect to network. I've tried it over Wi-Fi and also without, but got the same results. fix your bug please.

Gameplay is standard. Art isnt the prettiest but its better than anything I could do. Problem is the damn pop-ups and events. Its simply too many pop-ups and icons littering my screen and it takes up too much time closing all the notifications and advertisements for booster packs when I want to get to the game. Better merge games can be found elsewhere.

Graphics are neat and everything's pretty enjoyable at first. But once you level up a bit, you realise things in game are always rigged against you, even if you pay for a few stuff, it just becomes frustrating. You will never be able to finish any events or collect everything without spending money. I've tried as much as I could, but I think it's time to stop supporting this Dev who doesn't seem to listen to their feedback.

This game was advertised to me as one with zero ads, no play to win, unlimited energy and therefore endless gameplay. That was completely false! if you're checking reviews before downloading, please know that while the first two or three energy refills are free, after that it takes time or money to refill to play. Uninstalling now on principle. False advertisements.

Once you get to higher levels you have to spend if you want to play more than a few minutes. At first it's great and fun, energy comes fast enough to play for hours but as you level it becomes only possible to play for about 5 minutes or less without spending money on energy. It's greedy and deceptive. Then you do spend $40-$100 and you expect to be able to play for at least a month but NO even that is only enough to play for maybe 4-5 hours. GREEDY!!! This pay to win trend must STOP!!

I have played this game a ton. It has good graphics, constant updates, and some cute events. Early on, it's great. Then it will absolutely require money. I have spent an embarrassing amount. The 100 energy given is nothing compared to the frequent 200 of 300 needed for items. I've even had to use over 400 for one! Yes you can earn rewards & energy but you must be able to play to do that and can't play without energy. If you don't pay, it could be days to finish a goal. I've finally stopped.

I liked it until it automatically makes me use either four or eight times the energy when I don't want to. I have not figured out the way to deactivate this feature. it automatically starts itself whenever I get over a certain energy level. edit: it NEVER turns off, even if I'm under 100 units of energy. seems like this may be a bug needing to be fixed? per the pop up, it should only activate over a certain number.

Editing my review because I got 11 pop ups before just entering the game this morning, before doing anything. I counted. Not only is the original issue still happening, but twice this week I have even lost out on those little star bonus item things because I've been interrupted by pop-ups and forced into a different screen. This game is so full of event pop-ups that you cannot opt out of that it just makes it too frustrating to play anymore! :(

At first I loved this game, but no more. It is definitely a money grab. The way it is set up you have to pay real money to get any of the cool items such as the chests that contain energy and such. Normally, the game will give you an item that is a higher level so you can merge quickly. Unless you only have a limited amount of energy then you best believe that you will only get level one items even if you are using a 4 or 8 multiplier. And 100 energy at level 150 is useless. Don't waste money.

really fun to play. I enjoy it. There are some producers that you have to click on at least 5 times in order to generate one item (the one that generated the wood and blueberries for example). I am also disappointed in the fact that the add I watched (and downloaded from) promised ad $100 pack that included energy, diamonds, and all kids of items and I NEVER received that. so that is disappointing.

This was fun at first as you will see if you've just started. Yes, in the beginning you do get lots of energy and rewards. But the further you get into the game they give less energy and the orders get harder and harder using your energy up way too fast, barely giving much play time. Then having to wait 4 hours just to regain only 100 energy. 100 energy every 4 hours is not enough. If you keep playing you will eventually see what I'm talking about. Have fun wasting your time.

It's fun to play. However, there is a major downside of waiting for the treasure to open and having to spend to level up faster. The higher the level you reach, the more you have to spend. It doesn't just take a set of 100 energy to complete a merge. You have to make multiple and pay for more energy. if not, you play for a few minutes and wait until your energy builds back up. The spend aspect is greater than the actual play. Also, once you reach higher levels, the purchases cost more.

Honestly i never thought the torch would never be passed to another game regarding the most aggressive micro-transactions. Sorry Street Fighter you're now #2. Mystery Town doesn't hide things you can buy. They litter your screen with them. Seriously both sides of my screen are bubbles offering items for money. Even when you unlock things you have to pay for, that screen opens automatically. There is no mystery here. You love money. We know.

This game has fun side games & is really fun... until the sheer GREED shines through. It takes a million hits to get the one item you need almost like it's set up that way. Then the majority of the things you can buy that's more than a few plays are RIDICULOUSLY high price. $15 $19, & $40... like the economy isn't down. The money I did spend due to trying to complete a promo... wasted! I have one more level to at least try to recoup something & it's uninstalled! DON'T WASTE UR TIME or Money!

this game is fun but I seem to coming to a point that it takes an absurdly long time to complete orders because 1 generators has different categories so you waste a lot of energy to get to just get the few items you need 2 because the orders are requesting high levels of the items that aren't the main items you get so it can take thousands of energy to complete one order and it takes 3 hours and 20 minutes for 100 energy to regenerate. may delete soon 😕

The energy system ruins an otherwise enjoyable game. Having more energy - anything over 200 - actually hurts you because the game automatically increases the energy cost per tap. What starts at 1 energy jumps up a to 8 energy per item. Many tasks require merging dozens, sometimes over 100 items, yet you can run out of energy in just a few taps. On top of that, energy packs cost $3–$10 and are gone in mere minutes. The system feels designed to make us spend lots of money.

Do NOT waste your time!! I installed the game after seeing the ad which stated that players would receive a FREE $100 in-game package; THE AD LIED!!! I'm so sick and tired of these games saying one thing in their ads, then they don't keep their word!! I'd be VERY leery about the 5* ratings due to how they don't have a problem LYING! If you installed the game, after seeing their ad, with the hope of getting a FREE $100 package, uninstall it immediately. Google needs to delete these LYING GAMES!

Typical exponential game that starts smooth to hook you up and then from a certain level up it requires a huge amount of energy to complete the objectives. The intent is to push people to pay for going through the game, and after a while even when paying, things are too slow to get completed. Nice try bit I'll pass...

Interesting, until level 30. Keeps you coming back and spending money. However, there are many others out there that are better, more entertaining and will allow you to watch ads for more energy. This one isn't worth a dime. You'll buy a thousand plus energy and still not get what you need. It is not worth this much of my true energy to play this game or to recommend it. It's a zero compared to other games like this.

I'd like to purchase a credit pack but it's saying error your end. you don't want me to buy anything or progress? I don't understand why. it was fine a few days ago your help is all bots, nowhere to upload screenshots or get help. it's saying it's an issue your end. I only need to make an in app purchase to complete the weekly prize but I guess that can't happen.

So I'm redoing my review because I've noticed that once I hit level 100 just about every order has been level 10, even when it's a two in one order they are both level 10. I'm still enjoying the game but I've been struggling to complete anything because I run out of energy before I'm even close to what I need or it won't even produce what I need, I can't even get close to finishing any of the challenges because of low energy.I still wish there were easier ways to get energy or even diamonds.

How cool is this game? Level 23, not one ad so far. So much energy, so many events, so much to do, great generators, no glitches, adorable characters, great story. I'm not one bit upset with this game. Favorite Merge game ever played so far, really! please don't disappoint me.... Edit: Level 35. Disappointment has set in. Been on level 35 for many days. All the extra energy is gone. must purchase energy or wait hours for refill. No ads for rewards. Blueberry generator is so Very STUPID.

Developers are trying hard to loot the money by making the game difficult and reduce the prizes😂. What a shame. Totally GARBAGE. You can't complete the cards set until you pay the real money. Now the master bank needs to buy a VIP pass to get it. I have more than 20 master banks but I have to pay to collect them. You can't complete a single order in 24 hours. It becomes more difficult now and you can't enjoy it without PAYING. PAY TO WIN. USELESS. UNINSTALL IT.

Terrible customer service, don't waste your money. I purchase their vip pass thinking I enjoyed the game and want to speed up my progress. Unlike other games their vip pass have a timer base on event and not from the day you buy it. I bought the pass and it expired the same day, I contacted customer service and ask if they could give me another pass for free since I was a new player and didn't realize there was a timer. They pretty much said should've pay attention to the timer and too bad.

it's alright, there are definitely some things that they could do to make it more enjoyable, like have ads to watch to earn energy instead of having to use gems to purchase them. Also, the farther you get in the game, the more you need, NEED parts to continue which sucks because once you hit a certain point you can't merge the ingredients for the parts that come off the truck, instead the automatically get sent to you which I don't think is fair. There's more but I ran out of room.

Downloaded this game since I repeatedly saw ads that it had unlimited energy. Turns out this is not the case at all, which really stinks. I don't need a greedy developer telling me how long I can play their FREE game. I honestly thought I had dl the wrong game and checked twice to confirm I had not.

I downloaded this game because the ad showed a fun mechanic where you shoot matching cocktails across the table, combine them into higher-level drinks, and build satisfying chains for points. But the actual game is completely different: just a boring grid where you slowly drag identical cocktails together to complete repetitive orders. The most frustrating part is not even the gameplay itself, but the fact that the advertisement barely reflects the real app at all.

This is my second time trying to play this game. I have been trying to let this game load. Also, an hour total. I would highly recommend the company start looking to fix this. Because I want to play your game. Not stare at a loading wheel and the loading page. If I have to start googling explanations. Just to get told to clear the cache, force my app to stop then restart my phone. To hopefully fix your apps problems. I find that to be a failure on your half. Look into it or stop making them.

This game draws you in. Unfortunately progress is limited unless you spend real money for energy to continue. It's easy to do and next thing you know, you've spent a fair amount of your own money progressing in the game. I suggest you find another game where progress doesn't send you broke!

Fairly simple game of merging following a storyline , mini games to help progress. Downside to this game is prize crates after working like mad to fill orders, the prize crates take more minutes than usual to open. I have this game on Prime Opinion platform, and reach certain levels for game play rewards. And this game is not rewarding my efforts and not sure why , I have even paid for bonus gifts to advance. Level 51, and currently I am owed $8 so far . thanks for your time.

Omg! horrible just horrible. I don't know what the slide tile game was at the very beginning but I couldn't do that at all and then I get a merge tutorial which is totally unnecessary by the way, right away All the while horrible loud music playing which of course they have it set up that you can't get to your settings to turn it off. Wasn't it all what I thought It would be and I just closed the game and am uninstalling.

The game was fun at the beginning, with good rewards and easier progress. However, as it continues, the gameplay becomes too slow and repetitive. After merging items through many levels, I often only get one extra item for a single task, then I have to repeat the same process again and again. It becomes very time-consuming and feels like players are being pushed to spend money to progress. What started as an enjoyable game now feels more focused on monetization than fun.

I'm have been playing this for months and it's always been challenging with opportunities to refill energy through skill without spending actual money. This morning I woke up to a message that an already punishing generator has been changed and now something with limited rewards is going to take at least 1400 energy to possibly break. I don't know. I've spent this much without any advancement. This feels like a cash grab for veteran players.

the game is fun at first but it's so boring later on, you can't do anything without using in app purchases. you will never be able to complete the card packs and other mini games without being forced to pay real money for it. the energy cap will barely get you midway through an order unless you use all your gems. like everything just feels like a trap to get you to spend real money and it's so dumb.

at the begining fun. currently there is an event running to complete a puzzle. one day left but i just 'wasted' 200 energies today for nothing. I have so many coins it is ridiculous and hardly enough energy to get half through events. my team mates might think I dont want to play/help put the puzzle together. might give up this game bc it is no longer fun but just a chore for energy.

The constant pop-ups are annoying. When I open the app, I need to click through 5-10 different pop-ups - prompts to buy packages or notifications that an event ended. The worst part is the animations for the pop-ups are slow. It's just bad design.

the best merge game out there, I've tried dozens. good replayability, the board will rarely be overcrowded, generous with energy etc.. edit : you used to be able to get 200 energy a day by watching optional ads, that's no longer the case for whatever reason. downgraded to 4 stars

mediocre game play. it very quickly becomes super tedious and energy- costly to fulfill orders. my biggest grip is the story dialogue is probably written by ai... and poorly at that. it's incomprehensible at time. if Ai didnt write it, you should fire the person that wrote it.

This game is a rip off. I have played for a very long time but now I can not complete task because it doesn't give me needed pieces and it also takes away building pieces that I have earned. I can not level up the town and it gives you very little experience so the VIP gifts that I paid to unlock never become avaliable. I have tried to contact them but I don't get a response.

The game itself is fun, but please stop with the 20+ pop-ups when starting the game. When I open a game, I want to play, not wade though an endless amount of pop-ups and completely redundant "tutorials"

This game contains many package bundles. High cost. To get bonuses, you have to watch ads that frequently fail to play, so the bonus can't be claimed. So easy to waste energy but hard to collect it again

it's a nice game, but it's designed make you spend on energy. 1 why is it that even though you should collect 2 different item from a production item to make things for example the bread machine that makes bread and milk they will give a 50 breads and no milk that's frustrating. why have a machine that's designed to give two different items only focus on one item and even if you times two it's just higher bread for that I'm done playing

I enjoy the main game & the various short duration side shows, however it isn't possible to progress very far without spending money - & boy, do they ask for money A LOT! Anyway, I think my time using this app is coming to an end.

Best merge game of this style. The chances to accumulate energy allow for challenges to be accomplished. Although it might be a while to do that and with smart play and energy management. Downside, some generators are brutal in the later portion. The rare item in the racetrack is particularly bad. A 5 level rare item that generates only four items makes you spend at least a thousand energy to make a level 6.

some generators need to be clicked may be 10 times to ptoduce one item??? why??? and why energy is sooooo limited???? edit: i do appreciate your response, but what about having more generators than items? i have to uninstall this game because simply I have a board full of generators! this is so disappointng! I used to wake up every 3 hours to use the energy allowed! & now what? I have to stop using this! which is really sad!

I'm over level 100 now, but without paying there is very little chance of completing the timed challenges, and that's with me paying for the VIP season pass as well. That to me is the only genuine drawback.

Loved this game but can't play it now as crashing constantly. Can't even do 1 merge before it crashes, fix this please. Just updated and launched it 10 times to see if it worked but no. Try in a few days but if the same I will delete it

Awesome game, I really enjoy playing it however i gave it only 3 stars as the energy needed to play is too little and runs out so fast. You can only play for a few minutes then have to wait hours for the energy to fill up again. It would be nice if there were options to gain energy without spending actual money.

While the gameplay experience is smoothe for the most part, the consistent use of ai generated images greatly disvalued how much I enjoyed this game. I will not be spending any of my money on ai slop.

lots of events, so you can keep playing even when you run out of actions. what's most addictive are the bonuses from one event cascading in bonuses for other events and you can sometimes play for hours. very nice! one thing to note: some quests require way too expensive items, which can lock you out of daily/weekly events.

I truly love this game, but the side game where you use the orange energy cans should be readjusted. you don't get very many cans when you complete orders. unfortunately, when you go to use them to clear paths, the amount of energy that is needed for one can is a lot. and there is several cans in one spot.. can't the energy level be lowered as well as the amount of cans to clear in one spot..???

I am an avid online mobile game player. I use the platform mistplay and I saw plenty of ads for mystery town. I finally got the opportunity to download it through mistplay to earn rewards. I've been playing it for about an hour and I'm loving it. I earn rewards so you earn lots of energy to continue play. I highly recommend this game to everyone especially if you use the mistplay reward app. I would give this app 10 stars but it only goes up to five.

Loved this game until it became impossible to fill orders without spending real money. Once you spend money, you get rewards; otherwise, it can take days to fill a single order, waiting for energy to refill. Items in orders become all high level the longer you play.

This game is nothing but a money-hungry trap. They claim to offer free rewards, but the tasks to get them are literally impossible to complete. The levels become so ridiculously hard that you cannot pass them without spending real money. Don't waste your time or money on this greedy game.

I downloaded this game through another game because it said I would get an exclusive $100 gift pack. Didn't get it. contacted customer service and they said the offer had expired. how convenient. The least you could do is honor it since its incredibly misleading to promote something and not follow through.

took for ever to download on my Samsung A10 and took another for ever to start the game, then an update came says 48mb update but in my internal storage it shows 576mb storage Taken, Enjoyed the game for a while then when it started doing updates in the the game at start of every time I wanted to play it, became annoying because it takes so long to update 28mb/38mb/56mb/68mb/ what are all these in game updates for? cause that's annoying, sometimes you have to wait 10 to 12 minutes to update.
It's a fun game, but it takes energy to merge items, energy that runs out extremely fast, and the only way to refresh it is either to wait an hour or to pay.

Good game but when you watch a video for extra energy it crashes and you don't get it also some items take days to get just 1 and when you need a few to combine just gets boring blocking further rewards in bonus levels could be a good game but is let down by non existent support run by ai

Constantly crashing... suggesting that I contact you through the app when it's constantly crashing isn't really helpful. tried restarting and all the usual fixes producing no change. app stays up for about 30 seconds no matter what you do...

Got to level 37 and it became impossible to progress. Materials are needed to upgrade the buildings and level up. Completing the orders doesn't provide enough materials. Too much energy is required to complete even simple orders. Boring.

clicked on an ad which had a completely different gameplay for this game, and once I installed this, it has the same boring board with spawners and orders. the images about the game also changed from when I installed it (showing the other mechanic) to now. misleading.

Doesn't work at all. Sits and spins an hourglass on the title screen, never starts the game. Pixel 10, latest version of Android. Edit: restarted phone, cleared game cache as suggested. Still doesn't work. Uninstalled. Not chasing after the developer to fix it.

All good with graphics and what what. You get 100 energy bars. cannot go far at all with it. you need to purchase from the game to get somewhere and I am not going to do it again sorry. play time less than 5 mins. Going to delete sorry

yes you have to top up if you don't wait three hrs for 100 energy. Yes there are ads to watch to get free items. And no I didn't get the pack offered valued at 99$ in the Ads that Lears us into playing and misleading us. No you can't play 3 hrs. And no it is not unlimited energy.

why would you put an add on a video streaming platform to click and collect 5000 free energy when its not real, so disappointing to see this kind of behaviour from developers.
